map.🧮 手功能(九孔插板)标准时间计算器: 🧮 Hand Function (Nine-Hole Peg) Standard Time Calculator
map.九孔插板测试(NHPT)评估手部精细动作，计算标准时间和百分位: The Nine-Hole Peg Test (NHPT) assesses fine hand movements and computes standard times and percentiles
Core formulas (from the input variables): (domTime - ref.dom) / ref.dom x 100; ((nonDomTime - domTime) / domTime x 100)
map.1. 九孔插板为9个孔的方阵（3×3），孔间距3.2cm: 1. The nine-hole peg board is a 3x3 array of nine holes with 3.2 cm spacing
map.2. 准备9根插棒（直径1.6cm，高3.2cm），放在浅容器中: 2. Prepare nine pegs (1.6 cm diameter, 3.2 cm tall) and place them in a shallow container
map.3. 患者坐于桌前，插板放在正前方: 3. The patient sits at the table with the board directly in front
map.4. 嘱患者用测试手逐根将插棒插入孔中，越快越好: 4. Ask the patient to insert the pegs one by one with the test hand, as fast as possible
map.5. 从\"开始\"口令到9根全部插完计时: 5. Time from the "start" command until all nine pegs are inserted
map.6. 先测优势手，再测非优势手: 6. Test the dominant hand first, then the non-dominant hand
map.7. 如中途掉落，不需重新计时，继续测试: 7. If a peg drops mid-test there is no need to restart the timing; just continue
map.九孔插板测试广泛用于脑卒中、帕金森、手外伤、关节炎等疾病的手功能评估。时间越长表: The Nine-Hole Peg Test is widely used to assess hand function in stroke, Parkinson disease, hand trauma, arthritis and similar conditions. A longer time means worse hand function. It can be used to monitor rehabilitation progress and compare changes before and after treatment.
map.📚 深度解析：手功能（九孔插板）标准时间评估: 📝A In-depth analysis: hand function (nine-hole peg) standard time assessment
map.60-69 岁男性参考 22s±4s，实测 28s：偏离%=(28-22)/22: Reference for men aged 60-69 is 22s +/- 4s, measured 28s: deviation% = (28-22)/22 x 100 = 27%, Z = (28-22)/4 = 1.5, bilateral asymmetry about 12%, judged mildly abnormal and peg-board training recommended.
map.实测 21s，Z≈-0.25，在参考范围内，手功能正常，维持日常活动即可。: Measured 21s, Z is about -0.25, within the reference range, hand function normal and maintaining daily activity is enough.
map.Z 评分怎么用？: How do I use the Z score?
map.Z=(实测-参考均值)/SD，Z>1.96 为异常；偏瘫侧与健侧差值>20% 提: Z = (measured - reference mean) / SD, Z > 1.96 is abnormal; a difference greater than 20% between the hemiplegic side and the healthy side indicates significant asymmetry.
map.换手测要不要练手？: Should I practice before switching hands?
map.要。惯用手与非惯用手都测：健康人非惯用手通常比惯用手慢 5–10%，若差距明显超: Yes. Test both the dominant and non-dominant hand: in healthy people the non-dominant hand is usually 5-10% slower than the dominant hand, and a gap clearly beyond that range suggests insufficient compensation on the affected side or over-compensation on the healthy side. Before testing, let the patient practice once (not counted), then run the timed test twice and take the average; if a peg drops mid-test it must be picked up and reinserted and the timer does not pause.
